title: Analista De Negócios Em Ti
description:
A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local. Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança. A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características. Missão do cargo: Atuar como especialista em Desenvolvimento Organizacional e Business Partner, garantindo a efetividade do ciclo de gestão de pessoas e a construção de um pipeline sólido de sucessão. Ser responsável por conduzir e qualificar processos de performance, feedback e PDI, traduzindo dados em indicadores estratégicos que orientem decisões da alta liderança. Apoiar gestores e diretoria como parceiro de confiança, conectando iniciativas de desenvolvimento, diversidade e engajamento à estratégia corporativa, com maturidade, visão crítica e autonomia para sustentar a transformação cultural da organização. Responsabilidades do cargo: Conduzir e garantir o ciclo de gestão de pessoas - contratação de metas e avaliação de performance e comportamental;
Realizar Calibração -metodologia 9box;
Assessment - avaliaçãocomportamental;
Acompanhar e garantirfeedback de desenvolvimento dos gestores;
PDI ( Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) - acompanhamento dos resultados individual e em grupo, com mapeamento de ações e demandas de desenvolvimento e reconhecimento;
Mapa de Sucessão com nível de prontidão, com estruturação de agendas de retenção talentos e para as posições chaves;
Apoiar e conduzir localmente as ações de desenvolvimento dos programas corporativos: Mentoria, coaching executivo, ações internacionais, etc.;
Programas de desenvolvimento de times, como teambuilding, dinâmicas de grupos, etc. Requisitos e Qualificações: Grau de instrução mínimo: Ensino Superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos e/ou áreas correlatas;
Pós-graduação em andamento ou completo;
CNH B;
Disponibilidade para viagem;
Conhecimento em Excele Powerpoint, diferencial Power BI e/ou painel de indicadores;
Desejável: Ter atuado com SAP - módulo SuccessFactors. Informações adicionais Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica;
Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
Seguro de vida;
Vale transporte;
Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados. Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta! A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade. Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Auditor Sênior
description:
Junte-se a Forvis Mazars Se você quer uma carreira repleta de oportunidades, desafios, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador, venha para a Forvis Mazars. Sobre Nós Somos uma das 10 maiores empresas em prestação de serviços, reconhecidos pela nossa excelência e capacidade de fornecer uma experiência única aos nossos clientes e equipes. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável é alcançado através do investimento no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e novas tecnologias. Como uma empresa global mantemos alto nível de excelência garantindo uma experiência única através de qualificação, trabalho integrado, tecnologia e desenvolvimento contínuo de nosso time. Sua Jornada Conosco Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais. Sobre a área Na nossa área de auditoria, você terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional com interações e responsabilidades entre as principais linhas de frente de negócio, através disso você terá um contato maior com o time no que tange ao processo de auditoria desde o início de um projeto até o fim. Responsabilidades e Atribuições Realizar procedimentos de auditoria em áreas contábeis, financeiras e fiscais, com foco em questões complexas e que demandem conhecimento especializado;
Analisar demonstrações financeiras e contábeis, avaliando fluxos de caixa, tributos, custos, orçamento, e controles internos;
Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios de auditoria e emitir pareceres sobre as demonstrações financeiras;
Participar noplanejamento dos trabalhos de auditoria, assegurando que os objetivos e estratégias estejam bem definidos;
Fornecer suporte técnico à equipe e garantir que o trabalho realizado esteja em conformidade com os padrões de auditoria;
Desenvolver relacionamento com os clientes, compreendendo o segmento de atuação e suas demandas específicas;
Auxiliar na formação e desenvolvimento de profissionais, fornecendo feedback técnico e orientação sobre os projetos;
Trabalhar em colaboração com outros auditores e gerenciar prazos para garantir a entrega dentro do cronograma. Requisitos / Qualificações Formação em Ciências Contábeis;
Possuir CRC Ativo;
Excel Intermediário;
Conhecimento técnico e prático nas atividades contábeis e de auditoria;
Experiência com auditoria externa;
Inglês desejável Benefícios Serviço de telemedicina;
Rede de academias - Wellhub;
Canal de apoio psicológico;
Convênio com o SESC;
Vale Refeição/Alimentação (Cartão Flash) – flexibilidade para o seu dia a dia;
Vale Transporte;
Assistência Médica (Amil);
Assistência Odontológica;
Seguro de vida (SulAmérica);
Descontos e incentivos educacionais em diversas instituições. Se você se identificou com o nosso jeito de ser, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Aqui teremos diversas oportunidades e desafios para que você possa contribuir e se desenvolver em conjunto conosco.

title: Analista De Contabilidade Júnior
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento. Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a "verem mais e serem mais" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo. Irá apoiar em conciliações contábeis, apoiar as rotinas de fechamento e fornecer suporte às atividades contábeis das unidades do grupo, com foco em intercompany, provisões e controle de sistema Recon, garantindo conformidade, organização e cumprimento dos prazos operacionais. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES Conciliações contábeis intercompany e análise de contas patrimoniais (Executar conciliações e preparar análises contábeis com foco nas operações intercompany manuais) (Analisar contas patrimoniais e apoiar em lançamentos e classificações contábeis, exceto fiscais) Suporte ao fechamento contábil (Apoiar nas rotinas de fechamento, cumprimento de prazos e entrega de análises contábeis básicas) Classificação contábil e apoio nas provisões (Classificar documentos conforme o plano de contas e apoiar em rateios e controle de provisões contábeis) Apoio a auditorias e projetos de melhoria (Atender auditorias com documentação e esclarecimentos básicos, classificar documentos conforme plano de contas e apoiar em projetos de melhoria) REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS Graduação Completa em Ciências Contábeis com CRC Ativo. Conhecimentos Específicos / Habilidades Contabilidade básica e intermediária Conhecimento das práticas contábeis, plano de contas e estrutura patrimonial. Conciliação contábil Execução e conferência de saldos contábeis, especialmente contas intercompany. Fechamento contábil básico Apoio ao processo de fechamento mensal e entrega de análises. Sistemas contábeis e ERPs (desejável) Noções de sistemas como SAP, Oracle ou TOTVS;
Excel intermediário Tabelas simples, fórmulas básicas (SOMASE, PROCV, filtros, validações). Organização de documentos para auditoria Capacidade de buscar e fornecer documentação contábil para fins de auditoria.

title: Global Project Coordinator - Operations
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide. Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards. Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team. Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to): Operational Leadership Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics. Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators. IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business. Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives. Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager. Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards. Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development. Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed. CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager. Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required. Team Development Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start. Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training. Compliance & QHSE Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement. Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements. Commercial Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed. Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects. Team Culture and Engagement Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives. Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team. Client Account Management Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary. Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities. Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department. Coordination Responsibilities Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment. Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments. Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins. Qualifications and Skills Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role. Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore. Proficient in MS Office;
CRM experience preferred. Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments. Personal Attributes Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking. Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary. Additional Information: This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth. Travel Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region. HSE Awareness: All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations. Why Join Us? This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector. We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated. Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation. Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Coach Safety Leadership Training
description: Buscamos um profissional para atuar como Coach do programa Safety Leadership Training, com foco em desenvolvimento de liderança e fortalecimento da cultura de segurança comportamental e operacional. O coach será responsável por acompanhar líderes em suas atividades diárias, observar comportamentos de segurança em campo e conduzir sessões de coaching individuais e coletivas, de acordo com a metodologia DSS+.   Principais responsabilidades: Apoiar a implementação do conteúdo do programa Safety Leadership Training para a liderança. Realizar sessões de coaching com líderes operacionais, estimulando reflexões sobre comportamentos e atitudes de segurança. Conduzir observações de campo estruturadas (embarques, reuniões de segurança). Garantir a coerência com os princípios e práticas de segurança e apoiar a internalização do modelo dentro da organização. Elaborar relatórios e feedbacks para acompanhamento do progresso e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria. Garantir a gestão e controle dos treinamentos.   Requisitos: Experiência prévia em HSE, liderança operacional ou gestão de pessoas (preferencialmente no setor de óleo e gás). Facilidade de comunicação, escuta ativa e empatia. Perfil de coach ou facilitador voltado para desenvolvimento humano e mudança cultural. Formação técnica ou superior (engenharia, gestão, segurança do trabalho ou áreas correlatas). Disponibilidade para viagens e embarques em escala offshore. Desejável fluência em inglês. Vaga temporária *A Perenco NÃO discrimina por motivo de sexo, raça, etnia, origem ou idade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são também destinadas a Pessoas com Deficiências. As contratações da Perenco são baseadas nas necessidades de seu negócio. Se você se encaixa nos requisitos da vaga, candidate-se!

title: Desenvolvedor De Mainframe
description: About Olly Olly Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function. The Role We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking. You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking. Core Responsibilities Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data HubSpot Integration & Data Management Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy Technical Leadership & Team Management Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges Quality Assurance & Risk Management Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch. Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations Required Qualifications 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team) Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed Technical Expertise Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow. Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar) Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP Experience with VueJS is a plus Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google,, etc.) Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles Management & Communication Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members Performance Standards Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve Preferred Qualifications Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign) Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) title: L2 - Security Engineer
description: We are HCLTech, one of the world's largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: L2 Security Engineer - EDR Solutions (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne) Location: Hybrid, 24x7 Shifts Job Type: Full-Time (Rotational Shift Model, including weekends and holidays) Job Summary: As an L2 Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of EDR solutions by monitoring platform health, enforcing security policies, and troubleshooting endpoint issues across multiple EDR platforms including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne. Your role includes onboarding devices, validating security rules, handling basic policy enforcement issues, and ensuring that all endpoints remain compliant with security baselines. You will assist in resolving connectivity issues, missing telemetry cases, and agent health checks while escalating complex platform-related problems to L3. Key Responsibilities: · Ensure endpoints are successfully onboarded to EDR solutions across all platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android). · Monitor endpoint connectivity and health status within the EDR portals. · Validate that security rules, EDR, and antivirus policies are applied correctly. · Assist in troubleshooting policy conflicts and enforcement issues. · Investigate and validate EDR alerts, classify threats, and escalate incidents if required. · Apply basic remediation steps like isolating devices, initiating scans, or triggering automated investigations. · Identify endpoints not reporting telemetry or experiencing EDR agent failures. · Perform basic troubleshooting (e.G., restarting services, re-onboarding devices, checking connectivity). · Escalate complex security incidents and persistent issues to L3. · Assist in preparing incident summaries and compliance reports for management. · Ensure endpoints are running the latest security patches and EDR updates. · Validate compliance with security baselines and recommend corrective actions. · Collaborate with global SOC, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams for critical security incidents. Required Skills & Knowledge: · Hands-on expertise in CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne. · Ability to analyze malware behaviors, execute incident containment strategies, and escalate threats appropriately. · Scripting knowledge in PowerShell or Python (preferred). · Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills. Work Environment & Shift Requirements: · 24x7 support model with rotational shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays). · Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure SOC environment. · Excellent collaboration and coordination with global cybersecurity teams. Preferred Certifications: · CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA) · Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA) · Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200) · SentinelOne Certified Administrator At HCLTech, we don't just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way. Why Choose HCLTech? Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint Collaborate with diverse teams across borders Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion Ready to #FindYourSpark and be part of a team that's #SuperchargingProgress? Apply now or reach out to learn more about this exciting opportunity

title: Ai Technical Manager / Product Owner | Usd $70k-90k
description:
We are seeking an AI-focused Technical Manager / Product Owner to lead delivery for multiple AI initiatives. This role blends product ownership, delivery management, and AI-savvy stakeholder leadership. You'll own outcomes, organize work for fast iteration, manage expectations with demanding business and technology partners, and collaborate closely with an AI Architect and engineering leads to turn AI opportunities into clear, shippable increments. You are comfortable moving at a high tempo, getting to the point quickly, and keeping teams and stakeholders aligned while AI projects evolve rapidly. Key ResponsibilitiesTranslate ambiguous AI-related business goals into clear problem statements, prioritized backlogs, and sequenced delivery plans. Own the order of work: define MVP, prioritize by impact and effort, and ensure the first outcomes are meaningful and measurable. Manage expectations with business, technical, and partner stakeholders (including large cloud/enterprise partners) around scope, tradeoffs, and timelines. Act as POPM/PO across one or two concurrent AI projects, maintaining visibility, momentum, and alignment. Collaborate with an AI Architect and engineering leads to align business outcomes with technical implementation, without needing to be a hands-on developer. Facilitate Sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives with a focus on outcomes, learning, and velocity rather than ceremony. Anticipate risks and issues ahead of time rather than reacting late;
surface them clearly and propose actionable options. Ensure that business outcomes, user value, and AI capabilities are consistently connected and understood by all parties. Maintain strong executive presence in meetings: concise updates, clear decisions, and structured communication. Support scale-up of AI delivery by helping define patterns, governance, and ways-of-working that can be reused across projects. Required SkillsExperience as a Product Owner, POPM, or Technical Delivery Manager in software or AI-enabled projects. Hands-on experience delivering AI or data-driven products (e.G., LLM-enabled features, analytics/BI flows, intelligent workflows), with enough familiarity to reason about what's possible and how to get there. Strong backlog management skills: writing/structuring user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and ordering work to hit early wins. Proven ability to manage expectations and lead tradeoff conversations with senior stakeholders. High-tempo, high-ownership working style: you move quickly while staying organized and predictable. Clear, concise, and structured communication (problem → options → decision → outcome). Ability to work closely with architects/engineers, understand their constraints, and keep technical and business sides aligned. Comfort working across multiple parallel initiatives and adjusting priorities as new information emerges. Nice-to-Have SkillsPrior experience working with or alongside major cloud vendors or large enterprise partners. Experience in consulting, agency, or multi-client delivery environments. Exposure to OKRs or similar outcome-based planning frameworks. Experience in AI-heavy environments where the technology and partner landscape change quickly.

Join to apply for the Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore role at PRIO

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Buscamos Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore para uma das nossas unidades:

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Reportar imediatamente ao Gerente da unidade qualquer risco real ou potencial observado durante a execução de qualquer atividade, paralisando o serviço caso o risco seja iminente.
  • Treinar, orientar e compor o time de resposta a emergência da unidade nas ações específicas de resposta, organizando e participando dos exercícios e simulados de emergência.
  • Realizar palestras e treinamentos de segurança e meio ambiente conforme demanda.
  • Coordenar e apoiar o Gerente da unidade e demais departamentos nas ações referentes às políticas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.
  • Disseminar a cultura de segurança, através de ações para promover a segurança entre nossos colaboradores, com o objetivo de difundir os princípios de segurança e fundamentos de segurança de processo.
  • Coordenar as auditorias de Permissões de trabalho e inspeções nos equipamentos e sistemas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar o atendimento à Matriz de Treinamento da equipe de bordo.
  • Assegurar que a equipe de técnicos de segurança seja treinada e capacitada na aplicação das ferramentas de gestão tais como Greendocs, procedimentos, sistema de PT digital, cartão de observação, registros de incidentes, inspeções rotineiras, listas de verificações, análises de riscos, permissões de trabalho, entre outros, por meio de treinamentos internos definidos nos procedimentos estabelecidos pela organização.
  • Contribuir e ser o facilitador nas investigações de acidentes/incidentes junto à operação, propondo ações de melhorias por meio de técnicas de análises eficazes que garantam a redução e/ou eliminação dos eventos indesejáveis.
Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico)

  • Formação técnica de Segurança do Trabalho.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória

  • Sólida experiência como Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore e com liderança de times.
Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, queremos saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:
  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub‑projects.
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement and customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with involved government authorities to ensure smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking within the warehouse and across all venues where assets are provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities; movements of team luggage and equipment to/from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managing the entry of delivery and collection vehicles into venues during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading services, determining storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside venues, and provision of FFE.
  • Where required, development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP), and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf‑cart pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy in cooperation with tournament management, legal, procurement and all item‑procurement functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking and people resources as required.
  • Managing established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf‑cart provider) and ensuring all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Providing the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration‑management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attending site/venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meetings and events where an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g., Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics project plan, including mitigation and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruiting the Logistics team and providing leadership to the team.
  • Preparing and managing a health‑and‑safety plan.
  • Preparing and managing a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Providing timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Completing the final reconciliation, closing contracts and transferring knowledge post‑tournaments.
Your Profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics or event operations for an international event.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.
Seniority level

Mid‑Senior level

Employment type

Contract

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You
  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify pattern and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.

A General Manager is responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience while managing profitability and guest satisfaction measures.



What will I be doing?

As a General Manager, you are responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience. A General Manager will also be required to manage profitability and guest satisfaction measures. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Manage ongoing profitability of your hotel, ensuring revenue and guest satisfaction targets are met and exceeded
  • Lead in all key property issues including capital projects, customer service, and refurbishment

  • Deliver achievable hotel budgets, and set other short- and long- term strategic goals for the property
  • Provide effective leadership to hotel team members
  • Lead in all aspects of business planning
  • Comply with and exceed Hilton Brand Service Standards
  • Ensure costs are controlled and revenue opportunities are effectively sourced and delivered
  • Manage and develop the Hotel Executive team to ensure career progression and effective succession planning within Hilton
  • Hold regular briefings and communication meetings with the HOD team
  • Respond to audits to ensure continual improvement is achieved
What are we looking for?

A General Manager serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Experience as General Manager or Director of Operations within a similar quality hotel
  • Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent
  • Possesss strong commercial acumen, with experience in increasing profitability
  • Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar sized property
  • Excellent leadership skills
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • In-depth knowledge of the hotel/leisure/service sector

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • General Management experience in a similar quality hotel


What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands . Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.
Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)
Desafios e Impacto
  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar!

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura.

Join to apply for the Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle role at Águas do Rio .

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

The position

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament. This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Your profile

Your profile

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.
Your profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Staff Security Operations Engineer
description:
Overview

The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

The SecOps team’s mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role
  • Implement and evolve Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 50,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long-term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer-facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third-party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event-driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You'll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we're building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript, Next.js, and/or Node.js
The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list). Finally, you'll have back-to-back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.
